answer: Every identity buys misconduct insurance before it can earn: the premium is a base 8 POA multiplied by one plus half its funding-cluster size, so a vine of 200 clones costs 408 POA each, 81,600 POA up front. Claims are paid to defrauded users from that pool, and any confirmed fraud reprices every member at the next epoch pulse. Honest singles pay the timber-floor premium of 8 POA, half rebated after 90 clean epochs. Cloning buys no cost advantage: a thousand shells pay a thousand separate risks before the first reward.
